title: Calm Voice Reading Supplied Script
tests: Tests standalone spoken narration with exact wording and calm delivery, and recognition that speech synthesis is outside the listed free-tier tools.

exact_text.text: Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.
exact_text.read_as: Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.

faults.what: The recording is 7 seconds long, substantially shorter than the requested approximately 10 seconds.

judge.summary: The WAV contains the exact requested script, but its 7-second duration falls short of the requested approximately 10 seconds.

must_haves.item: The spoken words match the supplied script exactly, without an introduction or extra words.
must_haves.why: The supplied speech transcription matches the script exactly and includes no extra words.

must_haves.item: One voice reads the entire script with a calm, reassuring delivery.
must_haves.why: The transcription does not establish the number of speakers or their vocal delivery, and the audio cannot be heard.

must_haves.item: The recording lasts approximately 10 seconds without rushed or cut-off speech.
must_haves.why: The reported duration is 7 seconds, 30% shorter than requested; pacing and cut-off quality cannot be assessed from the transcription.

must_haves.item: Only speech is audible: no music, sound effects or ambient backing.
must_haves.why: The speech transcription does not establish whether non-speech sounds are present.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is a standalone playable audio file, not a video or a text-only script.
must_haves.why: A WAV audio file is provided with a reported duration, peak level and speech transcription.
